content.outro: The lane is walked to the byre at its end, past every holding on it.
content.premise: Holding Lane runs out of the village to the fields: a family's house on its lot, the smith's forge, a chapel, and a byre at the end where the lane meets the pasture.
content.theme: A lane of holdings, each planned with what it holds: a house and its cart shed with their yards, a forge with its work yard, a chapel that is its whole plot, and a byre with its pen.
content.title: The Lane of Holdings
